title: Draft
description: A node in the session's draft tree — a lightweight POINTER, not a data store. Lives in session.json's drafts[]. The actual scaffold/mix/verification/boss artifacts for this draft live write-once in versions/{version_label}/*.json; a draft node only carries tree metadata (parent, label, what-changed) so the skeleton stays small and team-commit-safe. Version labels follow v0.1 / v0.1.1 / v1.0 scheme from lib/session/version-numbering.md.

parent_draft_id.description: Parent draft ID. null = root of the tree (first completion of session).

version_label.description: Version label. v0.1 = first draft, v0.2 = main-line child, v0.1.1 = branch from v0.1, v1.0 = promoted release.

change_summary.description: 60 chars or fewer — what changed in this version.

directive.description: The revision directive that produced this draft (what was asked to change). null for the root draft. Set by /argus:revise.

reviewing_agent_id.description: The agent that produced this revision: 'navigator' for an /argus:revise child draft, null for an initial pipeline draft. (Boss review is NOT recorded here — a draft is 'reviewed' iff versions/{version_label}/boss_feedback.json exists.)

boss_reviewed.description: True if /argus:boss has run on this draft (i.e. versions/{version_label}/boss_feedback.json exists). A small flag for the version tree — the full feedback stays in the version dir.
